FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 64
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator Larry Stutts
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/09/2024
Senate Bill 64 as introduced would increase motor vehicle registration and license fee receipts
to the State General Fund, Public Road and Bridge Fund, counties and municipalities by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the number of off-road or recreational off-road vehicles
that would become registered pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
